name: Welcome!
summary: This errand introduces newly arrived travelers holding a special gift voucher to Merissa Stilwell in Goldshire. By presenting this token, adventurers are welcomed into the world of Azeroth with a rare miniature companion to join them on their travels. It marks one of the earliest friendly encounters for fresh explorers stepping into Elwynn Forest.

sections.title: A Friendly Face in Goldshire
sections.body: Goldshire is the primary crossroads and gathering hub for human recruits leaving Northshire Valley, making it the natural place for travelers to receive aid and supplies. Among the town's welcoming inhabitants is Merissa Stilwell, who stands ready to greet distinguished newcomers bearing special documentation. For those who enter the realm with a unique voucher in hand, she offers a warm reception and a small exotic pet to accompany them through their journeys across Azeroth.

sections.title: Tokens and Companions
sections.body: The gift voucher carried by honored adventurers serves as an official exchange slip recognized by Stilwell. Rather than coin or arms, the trade offers companionship in a world growing increasingly fraught with danger. With the kingdom of Stormwind stretched thin by Defias outlaws, gnoll incursions, and mysterious political tensions, even a humble companion beast provides comfort to those venturing beyond the safety of town borders.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The quest directs holders of a special gift voucher to deliver it to Merissa Stilwell in Goldshire. In exchange for the voucher, she grants the bearer a unique non-combat companion pet to follow them on their adventures.

Merissa Stilwell is a welcoming resident of Goldshire who handles special vouchers for arriving travelers. She greets newcomers to Elwynn Forest and presents them with companion animals as a token of goodwill.

faq.q: Where does this voucher come from?
faq.answer: The voucher appears in the belongings of select travelers upon beginning their journey in Azeroth, specifically awarded as a commemorative gift for holders of the original Collector's Edition of the world.

faq.q: Where can Merissa Stilwell be found?
faq.answer: She is located in the town of Goldshire within Elwynn Forest, standing near the town center along the road just south of the Lion's Pride Inn.

faq.q: Does this quest have any prerequisites or danger involved?
faq.answer: There are no prerequisites or combat required. The road from Northshire to Goldshire is completely safe along the beaten path, requiring only a short walk down to the crossroads to turn in the voucher.

faq.q: Can Horde players complete this task?
faq.answer: No. This specific voucher exchange is tied to Goldshire in Elwynn Forest and is meant solely for Alliance adventurers. The Horde has its own designated handlers in their starting settlements.

angles.text: For humans walking out of the Northshire gates into the broader province of Elwynn, turning in this voucher at Goldshire is often one of the first official town interactions they experience.
The crossroads of Goldshire serves as the heart of Elwynn Forest, where Alliance recruits get their bearings before reporting to Marshal Dughan and local defenders.
